description: Pub. 544 (2025), Partially Nontaxable Exchanges: like-kind property worth $100,000 plus $10,000 cash, the other party assumes your $30,000 mortgage, exchange expenses $5,000, adjusted basis $80,000. 'Total received $140,000 Minus: Exchange expenses (5,000) Amount realized $135,000 Minus: Adjusted basis ... (80,000) Realized gain $55,000 ... recognized (taxable) gain only up to $35,000'.
